## Why

<!-- Draft joined from the rationales; not yet confirmed by Mei Tan (SH-01). Review before implementing. -->
Programme minimum redemption (CAN-001) (R-013). Programme conversion rate (CAN-002, CAN-005); what happens to points below the next 100 is CAN-003, still to confirm (R-014). A voucher can be applied only once (PRD line 16; voucher state Applied in BRIEF.md:70) (R-015). Split from R-013 (review 2026-11-03 F-11); lifts R-024.AC4 and R-025.AC3 into the register (R-038). Lifts R-024.AC6 into the register (review 2026-11-03 F-13); members report vouchers refused at the till (CAN-017) (R-039).

## What Changes

- R-013 IF a member requests a redemption of fewer (must)
- R-014 WHEN the loyalty service accepts a redemption, the (must)
- R-015 IF the TillPoint POS asks the loyalty service (must)
- R-038 IF a member requests a redemption of more (must)
- R-039 IF the TillPoint POS asks the loyalty service (must)

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities

- `voucher-redemption`: members exchange posted points for vouchers (minimum, posted-points limit, voucher value), and the TillPoint POS validates vouchers at the till (already applied, unknown code) (R-013, R-014, R-015, R-038, R-039)

### Modified Capabilities

- None

## Constraints and Quality Requirements

None.

## Impact

- Register: `requirements/requirements.csv`
- Interfaces (`requirements/context.md`): customer mobile app redemption requests (rows 4 and 5); TillPoint POS voucher validation request and result (rows 2 and 3), defined by the TillPoint POS loyalty interface spec v2.1 (S-02)
- Sources: programme rules (BRIEF.md:61), PRD excerpt S-14 (`inputs/prd-redeem-at-checkout.md`)
- Open change: CR-001 (lower the minimum redemption to 300 points) is pending with Mei Tan (SH-01) and would change R-013
